headline: Indian Markets Rally for Second Day as Sensex Gains 390 Points Led by IT and HDFC Bank

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Continued foreign fund inflows driving market momentum
Strong buying interest in IT and realty sectors
RBI approval for NSE to launch corporate bond index futures
Positive carry-over sentiment from a massive 1,500-point surge in the previous session
whatHappening: Sensex closed 390 points higher while Nifty approached the 25,900 mark
IT and realty stocks saw gains of up to 3% during the session
NSE stock hit a 52-week high following a 35% rally over the past month
Government CPSE dividend collections reached 44% of the FY27 budget estimate
summary: Indian benchmark indices extended their rally for a second consecutive day, with the Sensex ending 390 points higher. The market was supported by foreign fund inflows and strong performance in IT heavyweights and HDFC Bank. Additionally, the NSE received regulatory approval for new bond index futures as its stock hit a 52-week high.
